$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007, FLR-ADR-064): FS_context 0.1.0, registry/FS_context/spec.md. Applied to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_context, by a validator that implements FS_context and knows it (spec.md 1.2). FS_context adds no kind of element and requires no other extension: its data is what surrounds a lot - streets, neighbouring buildings as massing and trees beyond the lot - records in the document's one space of IDs, never part of the design (spec.md 1.5). IDs that are taken, a street's repeated point, a footprint that is not a simple polygon and a gable or hip roof on a footprint that is not a rectangle are checked by the invariants (spec.md 1.3, 2.1, 3.1 and 3.2).
title: FS_context 0.1.0
description: What surrounds a house and is not part of it: the street with its curbs, strips and sidewalks, the neighbours as simple massing, and the trees beyond the lot.

streets.description: 2.1: the streets: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

neighbours.description: 3.1: the neighbouring buildings as massing: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

trees.description: 4: the trees beyond the lot: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

length.description: Core 2.1: a length, an integer number of base units of 1/1280 mm.

distance.description: Core 2.1: a length of at least 0.

positive.description: Core 2.1: a length of at least 1.

point.description: 1.4: a point of the plan, [x, y]: plan coordinates (Core 2.3), each a length.

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.

street.title: Street
street.description: 2.1: a road drawn along its centreline, symmetric about it: the carriageway, then on each side a curb, a planting strip and a sidewalk (FS-CTXT-2.1.1: no two consecutive points equal).

width.description: 2.1: the carriageway, curb face to curb face.

curbHeight.description: 2.1: each curb's height above the carriageway. Default 195072 (6").

strip.description: 2.1: each planting strip's width, between the curb and the sidewalk. Default 0: none.

sidewalk.description: 2.1: each sidewalk's width, beyond the strip. Default 0: none.

elevation.description: 2.1: the carriageway's elevation above project zero (1.4). Default 0.

neighbour.title: Neighbour
neighbour.description: 3.1: a building that is not the design, as massing: a footprint extruded to its eaves under a simple roof (FS-CTXT-3.1.1: a simple polygon enclosing a positive area; FS-CTXT-3.2.1: a gable or hip roof on a rectangle).

boundary.description: 3.1: its footprint in plan, a polygon (Core 2.6).

rise.description: 3.1: the roof's ridge above the eaves. Default 0.

elevation.description: 3.1: its ground, above project zero (1.4). Default 0.

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: 4: a tree beyond the lot: a trunk and a crown.

at.description: 4: where its trunk stands, in plan.

height.description: 4: the top of its crown above its ground.

form.description: 4: whether it loses its leaves in winter. Default deciduous.

elevation.description: 4: its ground, above project zero (1.4). Default 0.
